title: Deterministic escape hatch bypass
description: Implement ADR-0004 as code: an owner-reviewed must-never-miss list (host gone dark, backups dead) checked before triage and notified unconditionally, without the model deciding anything. Today the only enforcement point is a regex over src/prompts/triage.md, which pins prose rather than behavior. The list stays short and its contents are an owner decision.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text:
**What changed.** `src/escape-hatch.ts`: `matchEscapeHatch` (first-match-wins over a rule list), `formatEscapeHatchNotification` (deterministic text that never quotes the untrusted message/metadata/payload), `routeEscapeHatch` (match: exactly one `notify`, continuation never called; non-match: continuation exactly once, zero notifies; notify rejection propagates with no fallthrough). 7 mechanism tests in `tests/escape-hatch.test.ts` using fixture rules; the ADR-0004 pin stays on this file, now behavioral instead of a prose grep.

**What I did NOT do, and why.** The wire vocabulary (which field values mean host-dark/backups-dead) and the notification field subset are owner decisions — I implemented the mechanism with rules as data and shipped `MUST_NOTIFY_RULES` empty. Empty fails safe: everything flows to normal triage, nothing is misclassified, no silent notification path exists. When you answer the vocabulary question, filling the list is a small change with the tests already in place. The pipeline-level case stays an it.todo until the background seam (ticket 6e7eaef7) lands; per plan step 5 I created no competing pipeline.

**Red to green proof.** Tests written first against the missing module (import failure = red). After implementation 7/7 green. The exclusion test feeds a hostile message plus fake secrets and asserts none of it appears in the notification.

**Verification.** pnpm check green: 110 tests passing (105 to 110), 18 todo. ADR gate clean — the new file carries the ADR-0004 pointer, same-day commit, no drift. No ADR change: ADR-0004 already binds the behavior; the vocabulary answer will re-affirm it when it lands.
comments.author: agent

comments.text: Moved out of review: not delivered. ADR-0004 is written and pinned, but the deterministic escape hatch itself is not built — review implied it was awaiting sign-off on a finished change.

- Tests on origin: `tests/escape-hatch.test.ts` (7 tests, mechanism-level with fixture rules).
